units.source_text: 答：关于我们的生命，有各种各样的说法。

en.t: Answer: There are many different theories about our life.

units.source_text: 千万不要忘记，幸亏我们当中也有基督教、佛教、伊斯兰教、拜火教等各种宗教。

en.t: Never forget that, fortunately, among us there are also many different religions, such as Christianity, Buddhism, Islam, and Zoroastrianism.
